content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Dallas

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and documented work hours leading teams or managing projects. Granite PM Academy advisors can clarify whether your profile qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Dallas cohorts run on a schedule designed for working professionals, delivering the PMI-required formal education in an interactive classroom setting with expert instructors and peer collaboration.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required documentation to ensure your submission is complete and timely.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice assessments, and study materials to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the computer-based test when you feel confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities and resources to help you stay current and meet PMI's maintenance requirements.
